readiness.mainReason: The saving the whole recommendation turns on is asserted rather than built, so the client would be committing to a migration on an unverified number.
readiness.highestRiskIssue: The rollout on slide 14 starts before the saving has been shown to hold.
readiness.whatCouldChangeIt: A build for the saving with sources for each input would settle it.

blockingIssues.label: Headline saving is ungrounded and the recommendation depends on it

evidence.quote: Begin the switch in Q1 and complete migration by Q3.

strengths.point: The comparison axes are the ones a buyer would use.
strengths.quote: Three suppliers were compared on unit price, lead time and recycled content.

findings.title: The 2.4 million euro saving is asserted with no build or source, and the whole recommendation turns on that number.
findings.principle: A migration plan should not run ahead of the number that justifies it.
findings.diagnosis: The rollout is dated and sequenced while the saving behind it is still a single asserted figure.

evidence.quote: Begin the switch in Q1 and complete migration by Q3.

findings.why: The client commits capacity to a migration before the case for it is defensible.
findings.reflect: What has to be true about the saving before Q1 starts?
findings.fix: Tie the rollout gate to a verified saving rather than to a date.

findings.title: The rollout goes to full migration with no staged proof in between.
findings.principle: Implementation: a reversible first step de-risks an irreversible one.
findings.diagnosis: Two quarters from switch to complete migration with nothing staged.

evidence.quote: Client Z should switch to Supplier B.

findings.why: Every depot has moved before lead time is proven.
findings.reflect: What would the first quarter have to show?
findings.fix: Prove the switch in one region first.

learningNote.lesson: Anchor a finding to the slide that carries the evidence, not to the slide that carries the consequence.
learningNote.exercise: For each finding, name the slide a reader would open to check it.

notAssessed: Slides 6 and 7 are image only in the extract.
